name: 21053 · Freeland, MD
findings: ZIP 21053 (Freeland) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21053 (Freeland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21053 (Freeland) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
